info.title: Enterprise Developer Ticketing & Issue Tracking API
info.description: Production-grade Linear/Jira-style RESTful API featuring Multi-Team Scoping, Projects, Kanban Boards, Human-Readable Issue Keys (e.g. ENG-1), Optimistic Concurrency Control, and HttpOnly Cookie Auth.

get.description: Renders modern Scalar UI with live code generation and API testing console.
Raw JSON schema for code generation, Postman, or TypeScript generators.
Checks system availability and database status.

post.description: Registers a new user (role defaults safely to MEMBER without escalation) and sets HttpOnly access & refresh cookies.
Authenticates credentials and sets 15-minute access_token and 7-day refresh_token HttpOnly cookies.
Rotates access and refresh tokens using the refresh_token HttpOnly cookie (or body fallback).
Destroys both access and refresh cookies by setting Max-Age=0.

get.description: Fetches profile of currently authenticated user.
Lists all users for assignment dropdowns.

patch.description: Allows system ADMINs to promote/demote user roles (ADMIN, MEMBER, VIEWER).

post.description: Assigns a user to a team with role LEAD, DEVELOPER, or STAKEHOLDER.
Creates a project scoped to a team with a unique prefix (e.g. ENG, PAY) used for sequential issue keys.

get.description: Returns project tickets grouped into columns matching all 9 engineering lifecycle statuses for instant Kanban rendering.

patch.description: Atomically updates a batch of ticket IDs with new status, priority, assignee_id, or cycle_id inside a single database transaction.

get.description: Filter tickets by project_id, status (all 9 stages), priority, assignee_id, reporter_id, or search string.

post.description: Creates ticket under a project. Auto-assigns sequential key (e.g. AUTH-1) and sets reporter_id from authenticated session.

get.summary: Get Ticket by Numeric ID or Key (e.g. ENG-1)

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Expected ticket version for optimistic locking

409.description: Optimistic lock conflict: ticket modified by another user

delete.description: Sets deleted_at timestamp. Excludes from standard queries but preserves data for audit and restore.

post.description: Restores a soft-deleted ticket by clearing deleted_at.
Appends a Markdown comment and automatically parses @mentions or @emails.

delete.summary: Delete Comment (Author or Admin Only, Soft Delete)

post.description: Subscribes user to ticket events. Defaults to current user if body is empty.

get.description: Returns all active child issues / subtasks linked to this parent ticket.
Returns directional relation links (BLOCKS, IS_BLOCKED_BY, RELATES_TO, DUPLICATES) with embedded ticket summaries.

post.description: Links this ticket to another ticket with a relationship type (BLOCKS, IS_BLOCKED_BY, RELATES_TO, DUPLICATES). Target can be numeric ID or string key.

400.description: Cannot relate ticket to itself or invalid arguments

delete.description: Removes the relation link between tickets.

get.description: Returns all labels configured for the project.

post.description: Creates a new category label under the project with a custom hex color.

Label is already attached to this ticket

get.description: Returns all agile sprint cycles planned, active, or completed in this project.

post.description: Plans a new agile sprint iteration timebox with start and end dates.

400.description: Invalid date range (start_date must be before end_date)

200.description: List of tickets assigned to cycle

post.description: Batch assigns ticket IDs to this agile sprint cycle.

get.description: Returns total issues, completed count, completion percentage, and breakdown by status and priority.
Returns a chronologically ordered, paginated activity ledger for the given ticket (tracking status, priority, assignee, cycle changes).

parameters.name: id_or_key
parameters.description: Numeric ticket ID or project issue key (e.g. ENG-1)

get.description: Chronological system-wide security, mutation, and administrative audit logs. Requires ADMIN role.
List all personal access tokens for the authenticated user (raw secrets are omitted; prefix and usage timestamp shown).

200.description: Active API keys for the current user

post.description: Generate a new Personal Access Token (`pat_...`) with SHA-256 storage. The plaintext token is displayed only once upon creation.

delete.description: Permanently revokes the specified API key belonging to the authenticated user.

post.description: Receives GitHub/GitLab webhook events (pull_request, push) with optional HMAC-SHA256 signature verification. Automatically parses ticket keys (e.g. ENG-12), moves tickets to IN_REVIEW on PR opened/synchronized, moves tickets to DONE on PR merged, and appends automated system collaboration comments.

parameters.name: X-Hub-Signature-256
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 hex signature prefixed with sha256=

get.description: Returns a chronologically ordered, paginated list of in-app notifications for the authenticated user, optionally filtered by unread status.

patch.description: Marks a specific notification belonging to the authenticated user as read.
Marks all unread notifications belonging to the authenticated user as read in a single batch operation.
